name: Nathan Castle
abstract: Father Nathan Castle, O.P. would like to present a concurrent session for the 2026 conference. Father Nathan Castle, O.P., a Catholic Priest, podcast host, and author. His work lands in the mystical tradition of Catholic Spirituality. He has helped more than 500 “stuck” and not-so-stuck souls who died suddenly and traumatically to adjust to the afterlife.
